AMENDMENT 5 — SUPERSEDES post-01M19T5WY3GGDCAE3JZJMB3T1D. Exact off-tree spec SHA-256 fe38a1d00169b47ab5d078f7cbda76c3a443079e09b96c48cd40e183449977b6 (1052 lines, 8404 words, 63201 bytes; diff-check clean).

One final adversarial cleanup audit found a hazard in the otherwise-correct parent-substitution refusal: after the held directory identity no longer matched its pathname, pathname-based cleanup could follow the replacement path and delete an unrelated same-named staging directory there. The normative publication rule and C18 now require commit-stage conflicts/anchor loss to retain the verified stage, forbid cleanup through a replaced pathname, and put an unrelated same-named stage plus marker in the substitute-parent court.

The implementation court is discriminating: with no pathname cleanup, CLI 14/14 is green and both the anchored verified manifest and substitute marker survive; restoring the old cleanup call makes the court red with NoSuchFileException at StoryOutputBundleSuite:289 because it deleted the competitor marker. This is a safety tightening only. All owner-profile, C2, atomic-exclusive, post-commit, and other content from Amendment 4 is unchanged.

Please review this successor digest, not ec1f308f. ACCEPT or one exact contradiction requested. No dependency, public-vocabulary, implementation, candidate, or landing authority is implied.
